description: This file declares the StateObserver class which implements the IStateObserver interface. It manages session server states for different applications, providing methods to handle state changes, retrieve current states, and identify the active application. It uses mutex for thread safety and a map to store session states.

classes.name: StateObserver
classes.description: Implements the IStateObserver interface to monitor and manage session server states for applications.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when an application's session server state changes.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Returns the current session server state for a given application ID.

methods.name: getActiveApp
methods.description: Returns the application ID of the currently active application.
